title: Instanton and pillowcase homology of the $(-2,3,q)$ pretzel knots
summary: Hedden, Herald and Kirk conjectured that every knot admits a decomposition along a Conway sphere for which the Lagrangian Floer homology of the two associated immersed curves in the pillowcase recovers Kronheimer and Mrowka's reduced singular instanton homology. We prove the conjecture for the hyperbolic pretzel knots $P(-2,3,q)$; it was previously known for two-bridge knots and for some torus knots. The decomposition is obtained from Hedden, Herald and Kirk's decomposition of the torus knot $T(3,5)$ by Dehn twists along the Conway sphere, which act on the pillowcase by a linear shear.…
